title.narrative: Stepping Up Universal Access: A Multi-Sectoral Partnership Response to TB/HIV - Lesotho (01-Apr-2024-31-Mar-2027)

description.narrative: Lesotho, TB/HIV, Ministry of Finance of the Kingdom of Lesotho (MOF)This program has the following goals: Reduce TB burden by scaling up TB prevention, diagnosis, and care through a people-centred approach. Strengthen structures and support systems for integrated, efficient, and quality TB services. Prevent new HIV infections. Reduce HIV & AIDS-related mortality. Improve sustainable systems for health to support HIV epidemic control and End-TB epidemic in Lesotho. The objectives of this program are: Scale up TB prevention interventions to reach 95% of eligible people by 2028. Increase TB detection rate and linkage into care to 95% by 2028. Enhance support and quality of care to achieve TB treatment success rate of 95% by 2028. Strengthen structures and support systems for the TB programme. Intensify communication and advocacy for TB. New HIV infections reduced to fewer than 2,600 by 2028. Mother to Child HIV Transmission reduced to less than 2% by 2028. 98% of PLHIV know their HIV status by 2028. >98% linkage Treatment and Care. Reducing HIV related deaths to fewer than 1350 by 2028. Improved health systems for HIV and TB services

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP04

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
On-shelf availability: Percentage of facilities with tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of high risk AGYW (15-24) who say they used a condom the last time they had sex with a non-regular partner, of those who have had sex with such a partner in the last 12 months
TBDT-1 -Other 2 Number of patients (males) with all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
TBDT-1 -Other 1 Percentage of patients (under 15 years) with all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP04

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of high risk AGYW that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in AGYW programs
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of facilities that implement supportive supervision (meeting all key attributes)
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Number of high-risk adolescent girls and young women who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of high-risk adolescent girls and young women reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of sex workers who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of districts that produce at least semi-annual analytical reports
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
TBP-1 (other) Number of people aged <15 years in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Number of MSM who received any PrEP product at least once during the reporting period
Impact indicators targets and results for LSO-C-MOFP04
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
